```python
"""
Widget de Visualização de Logs
"""
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import scrolledtext
from ..styles import COLORS, FONTS
from datetime import datetime


class LogViewer(tk.Frame):
    """Visualizador de logs em tempo real"""
    
    def __init__(self, parent, height: int = 10):
        super().__init__(parent, bg=COLORS['bg_medium'])
        self._create_widgets(height)
        
    def _create_widgets(self, height):
        # Header
        header = tk.Frame(self, bg=COLORS['bg_medium'])
        header.pack(fill='x')
        
        tk.Label(
            header,
            text="📋 Log de Execução",
            font=FONTS['heading'],
            bg=COLORS['bg_medium'],
            fg=COLORS['primary']
        ).pack(side='left')
        
        # Botão limpar
        tk.Button(
            header,
            text="🗑️ Limpar",
            command=self.clear,
            font=FONTS['small'],
            bg=COLORS['bg_light'],
            fg=COLORS['text'],
            relief='flat',
            cursor='hand2'
        ).pack(side='right')
        
        # Área de texto
        self.text = scrolledtext.ScrolledText(
            self,
            height=height,
            font=FONTS['mono'],
            bg=COLORS['bg_dark'],
            fg=COLORS['text'],
            insertbackground=COLORS['text'],
            relief='flat',
            state='disabled'
        )
        self.text.pack(fill='both', expand=True, pady=(5, 0))
        
        # Configurar tags de cores
        self.text.tag_configure('info', foreground=COLORS['text'])
        self.text.tag_configure('success', foreground=COLORS['success'])
        self.text.tag_configure('warning', foreground=COLORS['warning'])
        self.text.tag_configure('error', foreground=COLORS['error'])
        self.text.tag_configure('timestamp', foreground=COLORS['text_muted'])
        
    def log(self, message: str, level: str = 'info'):
        """Adiciona mensagem ao log"""
        self.text.config(state='normal')
        
        # Timestamp
        timestamp = datetime.now().strftime("[%H:%M:%S] ")
        self.text.insert('end', timestamp, 'timestamp')
        
        # Mensagem
        self.text.insert('end', message + '\n', level)
        
        # Auto-scroll
        self.text.see('end')
        self.text.config(state='disabled')
        
    def info(self, message: str):
        self.log(message, 'info')
        
    def success(self, message: str):
        self.log(message, 'success')
        
    def warning(self, message: str):
        self.log(message, 'warning')
        
    def error(self, message: str):
        self.log(message, 'error')
        
    def clear(self):
        """Limpa o log"""
        self.text.config(state='normal')
        self.text.delete('1.0', 'end')
        self.text.config(state='disabled')






```

```python
"""
Widget de Painel de Opções
"""
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import ttk
from ..styles import COLORS, FONTS


class OptionsPanel(tk.LabelFrame):
    """Painel de opções de extração"""
    
    def __init__(self, parent):
        super().__init__(
            parent,
            text="⚙️ Opções de Extração",
            font=FONTS['heading'],
            bg=COLORS['bg_medium'],
            fg=COLORS['primary'],
            padx=15,
            pady=10
        )
        self._create_widgets()
        
    def _create_widgets(self):
        # Variáveis
        self.download_css = tk.BooleanVar(value=True)
        self.download_js = tk.BooleanVar(value=True)
        self.download_images = tk.BooleanVar(value=True)
        self.download_fonts = tk.BooleanVar(value=True)
        self.capture_states = tk.BooleanVar(value=False)
        self.capture_responsive = tk.BooleanVar(value=False)
        self.crawl_site = tk.BooleanVar(value=False)
        self.max_depth = tk.IntVar(value=1)
        
        # Grid de checkboxes
        options = [
            ("📄 CSS", self.download_css),
            ("⚡ JavaScript", self.download_js),
            ("🖼️ Imagens", self.download_images),
            ("🔤 Fontes", self.download_fonts),
            ("🎭 Estados (hover, etc)", self.capture_states),
            ("📱 Versões Responsivas", self.capture_responsive),
        ]
        
        for i, (text, var) in enumerate(options):
            row = i // 2
            col = i % 2
            
            cb = tk.Checkbutton(
                self,
                text=text,
                variable=var,
                font=FONTS['body'],
                bg=COLORS['bg_medium'],
                fg=COLORS['text'],
                selectcolor=COLORS['bg_dark'],
                activebackground=COLORS['bg_medium'],
                activeforeground=COLORS['text']
            )
            cb.grid(row=row, column=col, sticky='w', padx=10, pady=2)
            
        # Separador
        ttk.Separator(self, orient='horizontal').grid(
            row=3, column=0, columnspan=2, sticky='ew', pady=10
        )
        
        # Crawler
        crawler_frame = tk.Frame(self, bg=COLORS['bg_medium'])
        crawler_frame.grid(row=4, column=0, columnspan=2, sticky='w')
        
        tk.Checkbutton(
            crawler_frame,
            text="🕷️ Extrair site inteiro (crawler)",
            variable=self.crawl_site,
            font=FONTS['body'],
            bg=COLORS['bg_medium'],
            fg=COLORS['text'],
            selectcolor=COLORS['bg_dark']
        ).pack(side='left')
        
        tk.Label(
            crawler_frame,
            text="Profundidade:",
            font=FONTS['small'],
            bg=COLORS['bg_medium'],
            fg=COLORS['text_muted']
        ).pack(side='left', padx=(20, 5))
        
        depth_spin = tk.Spinbox(
            crawler_frame,
            from_=1,
            to=5,
            width=3,
            textvariable=self.max_depth,
            font=FONTS['body'],
            bg=COLORS['bg_dark'],
            fg=COLORS['text']
        )
        depth_spin.pack(side='left')
        
    def get_options(self) -> dict:
        """Retorna opções selecionadas"""
        return {
            'download_css': self.download_css.get(),
            'download_js': self.download_js.get(),
            'download_images': self.download_images.get(),
            'download_fonts': self.download_fonts.get(),
            'capture_states': self.capture_states.get(),
            'capture_responsive': self.capture_responsive.get(),
            'crawl_site': self.crawl_site.get(),
            'max_depth': self.max_depth.get()
        }
```

```python
"""
Widget de Barra de Progresso
"""
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import ttk
from ..styles import COLORS, FONTS


class ProgressBar(tk.Frame):
    """Barra de progresso com status"""
    
    def __init__(self, parent):
        super().__init__(parent, bg=COLORS['bg_medium'])
        self._create_widgets()
        
    def _create_widgets(self):
        # Status
        self.status_label = tk.Label(
            self,
            text="⏳ Aguardando...",
            font=FONTS['body'],
            bg=COLORS['bg_medium'],
            fg=COLORS['text']
        )
        self.status_label.pack(anchor='w')
        
        # Barra de progresso
        style = ttk.Style()
        style.theme_use('default')
        style.configure(
            "Custom.Horizontal.TProgressbar",
            troughcolor=COLORS['bg_dark'],
            background=COLORS['primary'],
            darkcolor=COLORS['primary'],
            lightcolor=COLORS['primary'],
            bordercolor=COLORS['border']
        )
        
        self.progress = ttk.Progressbar(
            self,
            style="Custom.Horizontal.TProgressbar",
            length=400,
            mode='determinate'
        )
        self.progress.pack(fill='x', pady=(5, 0))
        
        # Detalhes
        self.details_label = tk.Label(
            self,
            text="",
            font=FONTS['small'],
            bg=COLORS['bg_medium'],
            fg=COLORS['text_muted']
        )
        self.details_label.pack(anchor='w', pady=(5, 0))
        
    def set_progress(self, value: float, status: str = None, details: str = None):
        """Atualiza progresso (0-100)"""
        self.progress['value'] = value
        
        if status:
            self.status_label.config(text=status)
            
        if details:
            self.details_label.config(text=details)
            
    def set_status(self, status: str, color: str = None):
        """Atualiza apenas o status"""
        self.status_label.config(text=status)
        if color:
            self.status_label.config(fg=color)
            
    def reset(self):
        """Reseta a barra"""
        self.progress['value'] = 0
        self.status_label.config(text="⏳ Aguardando...", fg=COLORS['text'])
        self.details_label.config(text="")
```

```python
"""
Widget de Painel de Resultados
"""
import tkinter as tk
from tkinter import ttk
from ..styles import COLORS, FONTS


class ResultsPanel(tk.LabelFrame):
    """Painel de exibição de resultados"""
    
    def __init__(self, parent):
        super().__init__(
            parent,
            text="📊 Resultados",
            font=FONTS['heading'],
            bg=COLORS['bg_medium'],
            fg=COLORS['primary'],
            padx=15,
            pady=10
        )
        self._create_widgets()
        
    def _create_widgets(self):
        # Frame principal com grid
        grid = tk.Frame(self, bg=COLORS['bg_medium'])
        grid.pack(fill='both', expand=True)
        
        # Estatísticas
        self.stats = {
            'pages': self._create_stat(grid, 0, 0, "📄 Páginas", "0"),
            'css': self._create_stat(grid, 0, 1, "🎨 CSS", "0"),
            'js': self._create_stat(grid, 0, 2, "⚡ JavaScript", "0"),
            'images': self._create_stat(grid, 1, 0, "🖼️ Imagens", "0"),
            'fonts': self._create_stat(grid, 1, 1, "🔤 Fontes", "0"),
            'size': self._create_stat(grid, 1, 2, "💾 Tamanho", "0 KB"),
        }
        
    def _create_stat(self, parent, row, col, label, initial_value):
        """Cria um widget de estatística"""
        frame = tk.Frame(
            parent,
            bg=COLORS['bg_light'],
            highlightthickness=1,
            highlightbackground=COLORS['border']
        )
        frame.grid(row=row, column=col, padx=5, pady=5, sticky='ew')
        
        # Label
        tk.Label(
            frame,
            text=label,
            font=FONTS['small'],
            bg=COLORS['bg_light'],
            fg=COLORS['text_muted']
        ).pack(pady=(5, 0))
        
        # Valor
        value_label = tk.Label(
            frame,
            text=initial_value,
            font=('Segoe UI', 18, 'bold'),
            bg=COLORS['bg_light'],
            fg=COLORS['primary']
        )
        value_label.pack(pady=(0, 5))
        
        # Configurar grid para expandir uniformemente
        parent.grid_columnconfigure(col, weight=1, uniform="stat")
        
        return value_label
        
    def update_stat(self, stat_name: str, value: str):
        """Atualiza uma estatística"""
        if stat_name in self.stats:
            self.stats[stat_name].config(text=str(value))
            
    def update_all(self, results: dict):
        """Atualiza todas as estatísticas"""
        self.update_stat('pages', results.get('pages', 0))
        self.update_stat('css', results.get('css', 0))
        self.update_stat('js', results.get('js', 0))
        self.update_stat('images', results.get('images', 0))
        self.update_stat('fonts', results.get('fonts', 0))
        
        # Formatar tamanho
        size = results.get('total_size', 0)
        size_str = self._format_size(size)
        self.update_stat('size', size_str)
        
    def _format_size(self, size_bytes: int) -> str:
        """Formata tamanho em bytes para legível"""
        for unit in ['B', 'KB', 'MB', 'GB']:
            if size_bytes < 1024:
                return f"{size_bytes:.1f} {unit}"
            size_bytes /= 1024
        return f"{size_bytes:.1f} TB"
        
    def reset(self):
        """Reseta todos os valores"""
        self.update_stat('pages', 0)
        self.update_stat('css', 0)
        self.update_stat('js', 0)
        self.update_stat('images', 0)
        self.update_stat('fonts', 0)
        self.update_stat('size', '0 KB')






```

```python
"""
Widget de Input de URL
"""
import tkinter as tk
from ..styles import COLORS, FONTS, ENTRY_STYLE, BUTTON_SUCCESS


class URLInput(tk.Frame):
    """Campo de entrada de URL com botão"""
    
    def __init__(self, parent, on_submit=None):
        super().__init__(parent, bg=COLORS['bg_medium'])
        self.on_submit = on_submit
        self._create_widgets()
        
    def _create_widgets(self):
        # Label
        label = tk.Label(
            self,
            text="🔗 URL para Extrair",
            font=FONTS['heading'],
            bg=COLORS['bg_medium'],
            fg=COLORS['primary']
        )
        label.pack(anchor='w', pady=(0, 5))
        
        # Frame para input e botão
        input_frame = tk.Frame(self, bg=COLORS['bg_medium'])
        input_frame.pack(fill='x')
        
        # Entry
        self.entry = tk.Entry(input_frame, **ENTRY_STYLE)
        self.entry.pack(side='left', fill='x', expand=True, ipady=8)
        self.entry.insert(0, "https://")
        self.entry.bind('<Return>', self._on_enter)
        
        # Botão
        self.button = tk.Button(
            input_frame,
            text="🚀 Extrair",
            command=self._on_click,
            **BUTTON_SUCCESS
        )
        self.button.pack(side='right', padx=(10, 0))
        
        # Dica
        hint = tk.Label(
            self,
            text="💡 Digite a URL e pressione Enter ou clique em Extrair",
            font=FONTS['small'],
            bg=COLORS['bg_medium'],
            fg=COLORS['text_muted']
        )
        hint.pack(anchor='w', pady=(5, 0))
        
    def _on_enter(self, event):
        self._on_click()
        
    def _on_click(self):
        url = self.get_url()
        if url and self.on_submit:
            self.on_submit(url)
            
    def get_url(self) -> str:
        url = self.entry.get().strip()
        if url and not url.startswith(('http://', 'https://')):
            url = 'https://' + url
        return url
        
    def set_url(self, url: str):
        self.entry.delete(0, 'end')
        self.entry.insert(0, url)
        
    def set_enabled(self, enabled: bool):
        state = 'normal' if enabled else 'disabled'
        self.entry.config(state=state)
        self.button.config(state=state)
```

```html
    <script>
        // --- Data & Config ---
        const RED_NUMBERS = [1,3,5,7,9,12,14,16,18,19,21,23,25,27,30,32,34,36];
        // Racetrack Order (Left Column Top-Down, Right Column Top-Down)
        // Based on the visual loop:
        // Top Cap: 3, 26, 0 (Handled manually in HTML)
        // Right Side (Descending from 0): 32, 15, 19, 4, 21, 2, 25, 17, 34, 6, 27, 13, 36, 11, 30, 8
        // Bottom Cap: 23, 10 (Handled manually) - Wait, standard loop is 8 -> 23 -> 10 -> 5. 
        // Let's stick to the exact visual requested.
        // Left Side (Ascending visually from bottom? No, top down left side):
        // 35 is left of 3. 
        // Left Col (Top -> Bottom): 35, 12, 28, 7, 29, 18, 22, 9, 31, 14, 20, 1, 33, 16, 24, 5
        
        const LEFT_COL_DATA = [35, 12, 28, 7, 29, 18, 22, 9, 31, 14, 20, 1, 33, 16, 24, 5];
        const RIGHT_COL_DATA = [32, 15, 19, 4, 21, 2, 25, 17, 34, 6, 27, 13, 36, 11, 30, 8];
        
        // --- Initialization ---
        const leftTrack = document.querySelector('.left-track');
        const rightTrack = document.querySelector('.right-track');
        const historyRow = document.getElementById('historyRow');
        const brainOutput = document.getElementById('brainOutput');

        // Helper to create cell
        function createCell(num) {
            const el = document.createElement('div');
            el.id = `cell-${num}`;
            el.dataset.num = num;
            el.textContent = num;
            
            // Base classes
            let colorClass = 'bg-slate-800 border-slate-600'; // Default Black
            if (RED_NUMBERS.includes(num)) {
                colorClass = 'bg-red-600 border-red-400';
            } else if (num === 0) {
                colorClass = 'bg-emerald-600 border-emerald-400';
            }

            el.className = `racetrack-cell w-10 h-8 text-sm flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-white border border-opacity-50 shadow-md z-10 ${colorClass}`;
            return el;
        }

        // Render Tracks
        LEFT_COL_DATA.forEach(num => leftTrack.appendChild(createCell(num)));
        RIGHT_COL_DATA.forEach(num => rightTrack.appendChild(createCell(num)));

        // --- State Management ---
        let history = [];
        let simulationInterval = null;

        // --- Core Functions ---

        function getCell(num) {
            return document.getElementById(`cell-${num}`);
        }

        function highlightResult(num) {
            // Remove old gold glows
            document.querySelectorAll('.glow-gold').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('glow-gold'));
            
            const cell = getCell(num);
            if (cell) {
                cell.classList.add('glow-gold');
            }
        }

        function highlightStrategy(numbers) {
            // Remove old blue glows
            document.querySelectorAll('.glow-blue').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('glow-blue'));
            
            numbers.forEach(num => {
                const cell = getCell(num);
                if (cell) cell.classList.add('glow-blue');
            });
        }

        function updateHistory(num) {
            history.unshift(num);
            if (history.length > 8) history.pop();
            
            // Render History
            historyRow.innerHTML = '';
            history.forEach(n => {
                let bg = 'bg-slate-800';
                if (RED_NUMBERS.includes(n)) bg = 'bg-red-600';
                if (n === 0) bg = 'bg-emerald-600';
                
                const chip = document.createElement('div');
                chip.className = `${bg} w-8 h-8 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-bold text-white shadow-md border border-white/10 animate-[bounce_0.3s_ease-out]`;
                chip.textContent = n;
                historyRow.appendChild(chip);
            });
        }

        function addNumber(num) {
            if (num === '' || num < 0 || num > 36) return;
            num = parseInt(num);
            
            highlightResult(num);
            updateHistory(num);
            
            // If a strategy is active, check if it hit
            const activeStrategy = document.querySelector('.strategy-card.border-l-emerald-500'); // Assuming first is active for demo
            // In a real app, logic would verify hit/miss here
        }

        // --- Interaction Handlers ---

        document.getElementById('btnAdd').addEventListener('click', () => {
            const input = document.getElementById('inputNumber');
            addNumber(input.value);
            input.value = '';
            input.focus();
        });
        
        // Enter key support
        document.getElementById('inputNumber').addEventListener('keypress', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter') document.getElementById('btnAdd').click();
        });

        document.getElementById('btnClear').addEventListener('click', () => {
            history = [];
            historyRow.innerHTML = '<div class="w-8 h-8 rounded-full bg-slate-800 border border-slate-600 flex items-center justify-center text-xs text-slate-500">?</div>';
            document.querySelectorAll('.glow-gold').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('glow-gold'));
            document.querySelectorAll('.glow-blue').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('glow-blue'));
            if(simulationInterval) clearInterval(simulationInterval);
            document.getElementById('btnSimulate').classList.remove('text-emerald-400', 'border-emerald-500');
        });

        // Strategy Activation
        window.activateStrategy = function(name, numbers, confidence, cardEl) {
            // Visual selection of card
            document.querySelectorAll('.strategy-card').forEach(c => {
                c.classList.remove('ring-2', 'ring-emerald-400', 'bg-slate-800');
                c.classList.add('opacity-70');
            });
            cardEl.classList.remove('opacity-70');
            cardEl.classList.add('ring-2', 'ring-emerald-400', 'bg-slate-800');

            // Apply Blue Glow
            highlightStrategy(numbers);

            // Update Brain Text
            brainOutput.innerHTML = `
                <div class="animate-pulse">
                    <p class="font-bold text-emerald-400">Estratégia ${name} Ativada</p>
                    <p class="mt-1">Foco nos números: <span class="text-white font-mono">[${numbers.join(', ')}]</span></p>
                    <p class="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">Confiança da IA: ${confidence}%</p>
                </div>
            `;
        };

        // Simulation Mode
        document.getElementById('btnSimulate').addEventListener('click', function() {
            const btn = this;
            if (simulationInterval) {
                clearInterval(simulationInterval);
                simulationInterval = null;
                btn.classList.remove('text-emerald-400', 'border-emerald-500');
                btn.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-sm">auto_mode</span> Simular (Auto)';
            } else {
                btn.classList.add('text-emerald-400', 'border-emerald-500');
                btn.innerHTML = '<span class="material-symbols-outlined text-sm animate-spin">sync</span> Parar Simulação';
                
                // Simulate a game
                simulationInterval = setInterval(() => {
                    const rnd = Math.floor(Math.random() * 37);
                    addNumber(rnd);
                }, 2000);
            }
        });

        // Initialize with default state
        console.log("Racetrack Initialized.");
    </script>


</body></html>
```

```html
    <script>
        // --- Data & Config ---
        const RED_NUMBERS = [1,3,5,7,9,12,14,16,18,19,21,23,25,27,30,32,34,36];
        const LEFT_COL_DATA = [35, 12, 28, 7, 29, 18, 22, 9, 31, 14, 20, 1, 33, 16, 24, 5];
        const RIGHT_COL_DATA = [32, 15, 19, 4, 21, 2, 25, 17, 34, 6, 27, 13, 36, 11, 30, 8];
        
        let currentBalance = 1027.50;
        let selectedDirection = 'horario';
        let logs = [
            {time: '14:30:05', dealer: 'System', table: 'Init', type: 'System', result: '-', status: 'Online'},
            {time: '14:32:10', dealer: 'Sarah', table: 'Immersive', type: 'Entrada', result: '17', status: 'Processado'}
        ];

        // --- Initialization ---
        const leftTrack = document.querySelector('.left-track');
        const rightTrack = document.querySelector('.right-track');
        const historyRow = document.getElementById('historyRow');
        const brainOutput = document.getElementById('brainOutput');
        const logTableBody = document.getElementById('logTableBody');

        // Helper: Create Racetrack Cell
        function createCell(num) {
            const el = document.createElement('div');
            el.id = `cell-${num}`;
            el.dataset.num = num;
            el.textContent = num;
            
            let colorClass = 'bg-slate-900 border-slate-600'; 
            if (RED_NUMBERS.includes(num)) {
                colorClass = 'bg-red-600 border-red-500/50';
            } else if (num === 0) {
                colorClass = 'bg-emerald-600 border-emerald-500/50';
            }

            el.className = `racetrack-cell w-9 h-7 text-xs flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-white border border-opacity-40 shadow-sm z-10 rounded-sm ${colorClass}`;
            return el;
        }

        LEFT_COL_DATA.forEach(num => leftTrack.appendChild(createCell(num)));
        RIGHT_COL_DATA.forEach(num => rightTrack.appendChild(createCell(num)));

        // --- Core Logic ---

        function getCell(num) { return document.getElementById(`cell-${num}`); }

        function highlightResult(num) {
            document.querySelectorAll('.glow-gold').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('glow-gold'));
            const cell = getCell(num);
            if (cell) cell.classList.add('glow-gold');
        }

        function highlightStrategy(numbers) {
            document.querySelectorAll('.glow-blue').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('glow-blue'));
            numbers.forEach(num => {
                const cell = getCell(num);
                if (cell) cell.classList.add('glow-blue');
            });
        }

        let history = [];
        function updateHistory(num) {
            history.unshift(num);
            if (history.length > 10) history.pop();
            
            historyRow.innerHTML = '';
            history.forEach(n => {
                let bg = 'bg-slate-800 border-slate-600';
                let text = 'text-white';
                if (RED_NUMBERS.includes(n)) { bg = 'bg-red-600 border-red-500'; }
                else if (n === 0) { bg = 'bg-emerald-600 border-emerald-500'; }
                
                const chip = document.createElement('div');
                chip.className = `${bg} w-7 h-7 rounded border flex items-center justify-center text-[10px] font-bold ${text} shadow-sm animate-[bounce_0.3s_ease-out]`;
                chip.textContent = n;
                historyRow.appendChild(chip);
            });
        }

        // --- Features ---

        // Direction Toggle
        function setDirection(dir) {
            selectedDirection = dir;
            document.querySelectorAll('.direction-btn').forEach(b => {
                b.classList.remove('active', 'bg-cyan-500', 'text-white', 'border-cyan-500');
                b.classList.add('text-slate-400', 'border-transparent');
            });
            
            const btn = dir === 'horario' ? document.getElementById('btnClock') : document.getElementById('btnAnti');
            btn.classList.add('active');
        }

        // Edit Balance
        function editBalance() {
            const newBal = prompt("Novo saldo (apenas números):", currentBalance.toFixed(2));
            if (newBal && !isNaN(parseFloat(newBal))) {
                currentBalance = parseFloat(newBal);
                document.getElementById('balanceDisplay').textContent = `R$ ${currentBalance.toLocaleString('pt-BR', {minimumFractionDigits: 2})}`;
            }
        }

        // Log System
        function toggleLogModal() {
            const modal = document.getElementById('logModal');
            if (modal.classList.contains('hidden')) {
                renderLogs();
                modal.classList.remove('hidden');
            } else {
                modal.classList.add('hidden');
            }
        }

        function addLogEntry(num, dealer, table, provider, dir) {
            const now = new Date();
            const timeStr = now.toLocaleTimeString();
            const directionIcon = dir === 'horario' ? 'redo' : 'undo';
            
            logs.unshift({
                time: timeStr,
                dealer: dealer || 'Unknown',
                table: `${table || 'Table'} (${provider || 'Prov'})`,
                type: 'Input',
                result: `${num} <span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[10px] align-middle">${directionIcon}</span>`,
                status: 'Analizado'
            });
            
            // Only re-render if modal is open
            if (!document.getElementById('logModal').classList.contains('hidden')) {
                renderLogs();
            }
        }

        function renderLogs() {
            logTableBody.innerHTML = '';
            logs.forEach(log => {
                const tr = document.createElement('tr');
                tr.className = 'border-b border-slate-800/50 hover:bg-slate-800/30 transition-colors';
                tr.innerHTML = `
                    <td class="p-3 text-slate-400">${log.time}</td>
                    <td class="p-3 text-white">${log.dealer}<br><span class="text-[10px] text-slate-500">${log.table}</span></td>
                    <td class="p-3"><span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-800 text-xs text-slate-300">Manual</span></td>
                    <td class="p-3 font-bold text-cyan-400">${log.result}</td>
                    <td class="p-3"><span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 text-xs border border-emerald-500/20">${log.status}</span></td>
                `;
                logTableBody.appendChild(tr);
            });
        }

        function exportLogs() {
            alert("Exportando logs para CSV... (Simulação)");
        }

        // Add Logic
        document.getElementById('btnAdd').addEventListener('click', () => {
            const inputNum = document.getElementById('inputNumber');
            const dealer = document.getElementById('inputDealer').value;
            const roleta = document.getElementById('inputRoleta').value;
            const provedor = document.getElementById('inputProvedor').value;
            const val = inputNum.value;

            if (val === '' || val < 0 || val > 36) return;

            const num = parseInt(val);
            highlightResult(num);
            updateHistory(num);
            addLogEntry(num, dealer, roleta, provedor, selectedDirection);
            
            // UX Reset
            inputNum.value = '';
            inputNum.focus();
            
            // Update Brain Text
            brainOutput.innerHTML = `
                <div class="animate-pulse">
                    <p class="text-emerald-400 font-bold">> INPUT RECEIVED: ${num} (${selectedDirection})</p>
                    <p class="text-slate-300">> Processing cluster proximity...</p>
                    <p class="text-slate-400 mt-1">> Dealer: ${dealer || 'N/A'} | Table: ${roleta || 'N/A'}</p>
                </div>
            `;
        });
        
        // Enter Key Support
        document.getElementById('inputNumber').addEventListener('keypress', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter') document.getElementById('btnAdd').click();
        });

        // Strategy Activation
        window.activateStrategy = function(name, numbers, confidence, cardEl) {
            document.querySelectorAll('.strategy-card').forEach(c => {
                c.classList.remove('bg-slate-800', 'border-l-4');
                c.classList.add('opacity-60', 'border-l-2');
                // Reset border colors to their base class if needed, but for now simple toggle
            });
            cardEl.classList.remove('opacity-60', 'border-l-2');
            cardEl.classList.add('bg-slate-800', 'border-l-4');

            highlightStrategy(numbers);

            brainOutput.innerHTML = `
                <div class="animate-fadeIn">
                    <p class="font-bold text-emerald-400">> STRATEGY ACTIVE: ${name}</p>
                    <p class="text-slate-300 mt-1">> Target Sectors: <span class="font-mono text-cyan-300">[${numbers.slice(0,5).join(', ')}...]</span></p>
                    <p class="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">> Confidence Level: ${confidence}% calculated</p>
                </div>
            `;
        };
        
        // Sim Button
        let simInterval = null;
        document.getElementById('btnSimulate').addEventListener('click', function() {
            if (simInterval) {
                clearInterval(simInterval);
                simInterval = null;
                this.classList.remove('bg-emerald-600', 'text-white');
                this.classList.add('bg-slate-800', 'text-slate-300');
            } else {
                simInterval = setInterval(() => {
                    const r = Math.floor(Math.random() * 37);
                    document.getElementById('inputNumber').value = r;
                    document.getElementById('btnAdd').click();
                }, 1500);
                this.classList.remove('bg-slate-800', 'text-slate-300');
                this.classList.add('bg-emerald-600', 'text-white');
            }
        });

    </script>

</body></html>
```

```html
    <script>
        // --- Data & Config ---
        const RED_NUMBERS = [1,3,5,7,9,12,14,16,18,19,21,23,25,27,30,32,34,36];
        const LEFT_COL_DATA = [35, 12, 28, 7, 29, 18, 22, 9, 31, 14, 20, 1, 33, 16, 24, 5];
        const RIGHT_COL_DATA = [32, 15, 19, 4, 21, 2, 25, 17, 34, 6, 27, 13, 36, 11, 30, 8];
        
        let currentBalance = 1027.50;
        let selectedDirection = 'horario';
        let isAutoToggle = false;
        
        let logs = [
            {time: '14:30:05', dealer: 'System', table: 'Init', type: 'System', result: '-', status: 'Online'},
            {time: '14:32:10', dealer: 'Sarah', table: 'Immersive', type: 'Entrada', result: '17', status: 'Processado'}
        ];

        // --- Initialization ---
        const leftTrack = document.querySelector('.left-track');
        const rightTrack = document.querySelector('.right-track');
        const topHistoryRow = document.getElementById('topHistoryRow');
        const brainOutput = document.getElementById('brainOutput');
        const logTableBody = document.getElementById('logTableBody');

        // Helper: Create Racetrack Cell
        function createCell(num) {
            const el = document.createElement('div');
            el.id = `cell-${num}`;
            el.dataset.num = num;
            el.textContent = num;
            
            let colorClass = 'bg-slate-900 border-slate-600'; 
            if (RED_NUMBERS.includes(num)) {
                colorClass = 'bg-red-600 border-red-500/50';
            } else if (num === 0) {
                colorClass = 'bg-emerald-600 border-emerald-500/50';
            }

            el.className = `racetrack-cell w-9 h-7 text-xs flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-white border border-opacity-40 shadow-sm z-10 rounded-sm ${colorClass}`;
            return el;
        }

        LEFT_COL_DATA.forEach(num => leftTrack.appendChild(createCell(num)));
        RIGHT_COL_DATA.forEach(num => rightTrack.appendChild(createCell(num)));

        // --- Core Logic ---

        function getCell(num) { return document.getElementById(`cell-${num}`); }

        function highlightResult(num) {
            document.querySelectorAll('.glow-gold').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('glow-gold'));
            const cell = getCell(num);
            if (cell) cell.classList.add('glow-gold');
        }

        function highlightStrategy(numbers) {
            document.querySelectorAll('.glow-blue').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('glow-blue'));
            numbers.forEach(num => {
                const cell = getCell(num);
                if (cell) cell.classList.add('glow-blue');
            });
        }

        let history = [];
        function updateHistory(num) {
            history.unshift(num);
            if (history.length > 12) history.pop();
            
            topHistoryRow.innerHTML = '';
            history.forEach(n => {
                let bg = 'bg-slate-800 border-slate-600';
                let text = 'text-white';
                if (RED_NUMBERS.includes(n)) { bg = 'bg-red-600 border-red-500'; }
                else if (n === 0) { bg = 'bg-emerald-600 border-emerald-500'; }
                
                const chip = document.createElement('div');
                chip.className = `${bg} w-8 h-8 rounded-full border flex items-center justify-center text-xs font-bold ${text} shadow-md animate-[bounce_0.3s_ease-out]`;
                chip.textContent = n;
                topHistoryRow.appendChild(chip);
            });
        }

        // --- Features ---

        // Direction Control
        function setDirection(dir) {
            selectedDirection = dir;
            document.querySelectorAll('.direction-btn').forEach(b => {
                b.classList.remove('active', 'bg-cyan-500', 'text-white', 'border-cyan-500');
                b.classList.add('text-slate-400', 'border-transparent');
            });
            
            const btn = dir === 'horario' ? document.getElementById('btnClock') : document.getElementById('btnAnti');
            btn.classList.add('active', 'bg-cyan-500', 'text-white', 'border-cyan-500');
            btn.classList.remove('text-slate-400', 'border-transparent');
        }

        // Toggle Auto Switch Logic
        function toggleAutoSwitch() {
            const checkbox = document.getElementById('toggleAuto');
            checkbox.checked = !checkbox.checked;
            isAutoToggle = checkbox.checked;
            
            const label = document.getElementById('labelAuto');
            label.className = isAutoToggle 
                ? 'text-[9px] text-emerald-400 font-bold uppercase transition-colors' 
                : 'text-[9px] text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase transition-colors';
        }

        function autoFlipDirection() {
            if (!isAutoToggle) return;
            const newDir = selectedDirection === 'horario' ? 'anti' : 'horario';
            setDirection(newDir);
        }

        // Edit Balance
        function editBalance() {
            const newBal = prompt("Novo saldo (apenas números):", currentBalance.toFixed(2));
            if (newBal && !isNaN(parseFloat(newBal))) {
                currentBalance = parseFloat(newBal);
                document.getElementById('balanceDisplay').textContent = `R$ ${currentBalance.toLocaleString('pt-BR', {minimumFractionDigits: 2})}`;
            }
        }

        // Log System
        function toggleLogModal() {
            const modal = document.getElementById('logModal');
            if (modal.classList.contains('hidden')) {
                renderLogs();
                modal.classList.remove('hidden');
            } else {
                modal.classList.add('hidden');
            }
        }

        function addLogEntry(num, dealer, table, provider, dir) {
            const now = new Date();
            const timeStr = now.toLocaleTimeString();
            const directionIcon = dir === 'horario' ? 'redo' : 'undo';
            
            logs.unshift({
                time: timeStr,
                dealer: dealer || 'Unknown',
                table: `${table || 'Table'} (${provider || 'Prov'})`,
                type: 'Input',
                result: `${num} <span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[10px] align-middle">${directionIcon}</span>`,
                status: 'Analizado'
            });
            
            if (!document.getElementById('logModal').classList.contains('hidden')) {
                renderLogs();
            }
        }

        function renderLogs() {
            logTableBody.innerHTML = '';
            logs.forEach(log => {
                const tr = document.createElement('tr');
                tr.className = 'border-b border-slate-800/50 hover:bg-slate-800/30 transition-colors';
                tr.innerHTML = `
                    <td class="p-3 text-slate-400">${log.time}</td>
                    <td class="p-3 text-white">${log.dealer}<br><span class="text-[10px] text-slate-500">${log.table}</span></td>
                    <td class="p-3"><span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-800 text-xs text-slate-300">Manual</span></td>
                    <td class="p-3 font-bold text-cyan-400">${log.result}</td>
                    <td class="p-3"><span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 text-xs border border-emerald-500/20">${log.status}</span></td>
                `;
                logTableBody.appendChild(tr);
            });
        }

        function exportLogs() {
            alert("Exportando logs para CSV... (Simulação)");
        }

        // Add Logic
        document.getElementById('btnAdd').addEventListener('click', () => {
            const inputNum = document.getElementById('inputNumber');
            const dealer = document.getElementById('inputDealer').value;
            const roleta = document.getElementById('inputRoleta').value;
            const provedor = document.getElementById('inputProvedor').value;
            const val = inputNum.value;

            if (val === '' || val < 0 || val > 36) return;

            const num = parseInt(val);
            highlightResult(num);
            updateHistory(num);
            addLogEntry(num, dealer, roleta, provedor, selectedDirection);
            
            // Auto Flip Direction
            autoFlipDirection();

            // UX Reset
            inputNum.value = '';
            inputNum.focus();
            
            // Update Brain Text
            brainOutput.innerHTML = `
                <div class="animate-pulse">
                    <p class="text-emerald-400 font-bold">> INPUT RECEIVED: ${num} (${selectedDirection})</p>
                    <p class="text-slate-300">> Processing cluster proximity...</p>
                    <p class="text-slate-400 mt-1">> Dealer: ${dealer || 'N/A'} | Table: ${roleta || 'N/A'}</p>
                </div>
            `;
        });
        
        // Enter Key Support
        document.getElementById('inputNumber').addEventListener('keypress', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter') document.getElementById('btnAdd').click();
        });

        // Strategy Activation
        window.activateStrategy = function(name, numbers, confidence, cardEl) {
            document.querySelectorAll('.strategy-card').forEach(c => {
                c.classList.remove('bg-slate-800', 'border-l-4');
                c.classList.add('opacity-60', 'border-l-2');
            });
            cardEl.classList.remove('opacity-60', 'border-l-2');
            cardEl.classList.add('bg-slate-800', 'border-l-4');

            highlightStrategy(numbers);

            brainOutput.innerHTML = `
                <div class="animate-fadeIn">
                    <p class="font-bold text-emerald-400">> STRATEGY ACTIVE: ${name}</p>
                    <p class="text-slate-300 mt-1">> Target Sectors: <span class="font-mono text-cyan-300">[${numbers.slice(0,5).join(', ')}...]</span></p>
                    <p class="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">> Confidence Level: ${confidence}% calculated</p>
                </div>
            `;
        };
        
        // Sim Button
        let simInterval = null;
        document.getElementById('btnSimulate').addEventListener('click', function() {
            if (simInterval) {
                clearInterval(simInterval);
                simInterval = null;
                this.classList.remove('bg-emerald-600', 'text-white');
                this.classList.add('bg-slate-800', 'text-slate-300');
            } else {
                simInterval = setInterval(() => {
                    const r = Math.floor(Math.random() * 37);
                    document.getElementById('inputNumber').value = r;
                    document.getElementById('btnAdd').click();
                }, 1500);
                this.classList.remove('bg-slate-800', 'text-slate-300');
                this.classList.add('bg-emerald-600', 'text-white');
            }
        });

        // Init Direction Button State
        setDirection('horario');

    </script>

</body></html>
```

```html
    <script>
        // --- Data & Config ---
        const RED_NUMBERS = [1,3,5,7,9,12,14,16,18,19,21,23,25,27,30,32,34,36];
        const LEFT_COL_DATA = [35, 12, 28, 7, 29, 18, 22, 9, 31, 14, 20, 1, 33, 16, 24, 5];
        const RIGHT_COL_DATA = [32, 15, 19, 4, 21, 2, 25, 17, 34, 6, 27, 13, 36, 11, 30, 8];
        
        let currentBalance = 1027.50;
        let selectedDirection = 'horario';
        let isAutoToggle = false;
        
        let logs = [
            {time: '14:30:05', dealer: 'System', table: 'Init', type: 'System', result: '-', status: 'Online'},
            {time: '14:32:10', dealer: 'Sarah', table: 'Immersive', type: 'Entrada', result: '17', status: 'Processado'}
        ];

        // --- Initialization ---
        const leftTrack = document.querySelector('.left-track');
        const rightTrack = document.querySelector('.right-track');
        const topHistoryRow = document.getElementById('topHistoryRow');
        const brainOutput = document.getElementById('brainOutput');
        const logTableBody = document.getElementById('logTableBody');

        // Helper: Create Racetrack Cell (Used for both track and history to match model)
        function createCell(num, isTrack = true) {
            const el = document.createElement('div');
            
            // Basic identification
            if(isTrack) {
                el.id = `cell-${num}`;
                el.dataset.num = num;
            }
            
            el.textContent = num;
            
            let colorClass = 'bg-slate-900 border-slate-600'; 
            if (RED_NUMBERS.includes(num)) {
                colorClass = 'bg-red-600 border-red-500/50';
            } else if (num === 0) {
                colorClass = 'bg-emerald-600 border-emerald-500/50';
            }

            // Dimensions differ slightly between track (fixed) and history (flex)
            const dimensions = isTrack ? 'w-9 h-7' : 'w-8 h-10';
            const extraClasses = isTrack ? 'z-10' : 'animate-[bounce_0.3s_ease-out]';

            el.className = `racetrack-cell ${dimensions} text-xs flex items-center justify-center font-bold text-white border border-opacity-40 shadow-sm rounded-md ${colorClass} ${extraClasses}`;
            return el;
        }

        // Populate Main Track
        LEFT_COL_DATA.forEach(num => leftTrack.appendChild(createCell(num)));
        RIGHT_COL_DATA.forEach(num => rightTrack.appendChild(createCell(num)));

        // --- Core Logic ---

        function getCell(num) { return document.getElementById(`cell-${num}`); }

        function highlightResult(num) {
            document.querySelectorAll('.glow-gold').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('glow-gold'));
            const cell = getCell(num);
            if (cell) cell.classList.add('glow-gold');
        }

        function highlightStrategy(numbers) {
            document.querySelectorAll('.glow-blue').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('glow-blue'));
            numbers.forEach(num => {
                const cell = getCell(num);
                if (cell) cell.classList.add('glow-blue');
            });
        }

        let history = [];
        function updateHistory(num) {
            history.unshift(num);
            if (history.length > 12) history.pop();
            
            topHistoryRow.innerHTML = '';
            history.forEach(n => {
                // Use createCell with isTrack=false to get the same "model" but sized for history
                const chip = createCell(n, false);
                topHistoryRow.appendChild(chip);
            });
        }

        // --- Features ---

        // Direction Control
        function setDirection(dir) {
            selectedDirection = dir;
            document.querySelectorAll('.direction-btn').forEach(b => {
                b.classList.remove('active', 'bg-cyan-500', 'text-white', 'border-cyan-500');
                b.classList.add('text-slate-400', 'border-transparent');
            });
            
            const btn = dir === 'horario' ? document.getElementById('btnClock') : document.getElementById('btnAnti');
            btn.classList.add('active', 'bg-cyan-500', 'text-white', 'border-cyan-500');
            btn.classList.remove('text-slate-400', 'border-transparent');
        }

        // Toggle Auto Switch Logic
        function toggleAutoSwitch() {
            const checkbox = document.getElementById('toggleAuto');
            checkbox.checked = !checkbox.checked;
            isAutoToggle = checkbox.checked;
            
            const label = document.getElementById('labelAuto');
            label.className = isAutoToggle 
                ? 'text-[9px] text-emerald-400 font-bold uppercase transition-colors' 
                : 'text-[9px] text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase transition-colors';
        }

        function autoFlipDirection() {
            if (!isAutoToggle) return;
            const newDir = selectedDirection === 'horario' ? 'anti' : 'horario';
            setDirection(newDir);
        }

        // Edit Balance
        function editBalance() {
            const newBal = prompt("Novo saldo (apenas números):", currentBalance.toFixed(2));
            if (newBal && !isNaN(parseFloat(newBal))) {
                currentBalance = parseFloat(newBal);
                document.getElementById('balanceDisplay').textContent = `R$ ${currentBalance.toLocaleString('pt-BR', {minimumFractionDigits: 2})}`;
            }
        }

        // Log System
        function toggleLogModal() {
            const modal = document.getElementById('logModal');
            if (modal.classList.contains('hidden')) {
                renderLogs();
                modal.classList.remove('hidden');
            } else {
                modal.classList.add('hidden');
            }
        }

        function addLogEntry(num, dealer, table, provider, dir) {
            const now = new Date();
            const timeStr = now.toLocaleTimeString();
            const directionIcon = dir === 'horario' ? 'redo' : 'undo';
            
            logs.unshift({
                time: timeStr,
                dealer: dealer || 'Unknown',
                table: `${table || 'Table'} (${provider || 'Prov'})`,
                type: 'Input',
                result: `${num} <span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[10px] align-middle">${directionIcon}</span>`,
                status: 'Analizado'
            });
            
            if (!document.getElementById('logModal').classList.contains('hidden')) {
                renderLogs();
            }
        }

        function renderLogs() {
            logTableBody.innerHTML = '';
            logs.forEach(log => {
                const tr = document.createElement('tr');
                tr.className = 'border-b border-slate-800/50 hover:bg-slate-800/30 transition-colors';
                tr.innerHTML = `
                    <td class="p-3 text-slate-400">${log.time}</td>
                    <td class="p-3 text-white">${log.dealer}<br><span class="text-[10px] text-slate-500">${log.table}</span></td>
                    <td class="p-3"><span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-800 text-xs text-slate-300">Manual</span></td>
                    <td class="p-3 font-bold text-cyan-400">${log.result}</td>
                    <td class="p-3"><span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 text-xs border border-emerald-500/20">${log.status}</span></td>
                `;
                logTableBody.appendChild(tr);
            });
        }

        function exportLogs() {
            alert("Exportando logs para CSV... (Simulação)");
        }

        // Add Logic
        document.getElementById('btnAdd').addEventListener('click', () => {
            const inputNum = document.getElementById('inputNumber');
            const dealer = document.getElementById('inputDealer').value;
            const roleta = document.getElementById('inputRoleta').value;
            const provedor = document.getElementById('inputProvedor').value;
            const val = inputNum.value;

            if (val === '' || val < 0 || val > 36) return;

            const num = parseInt(val);
            highlightResult(num);
            updateHistory(num);
            addLogEntry(num, dealer, roleta, provedor, selectedDirection);
            
            // Auto Flip Direction
            autoFlipDirection();

            // UX Reset
            inputNum.value = '';
            inputNum.focus();
            
            // Update Brain Text
            brainOutput.innerHTML = `
                <div class="animate-pulse">
                    <p class="text-emerald-400 font-bold">> INPUT RECEIVED: ${num} (${selectedDirection})</p>
                    <p class="text-slate-300">> Processing cluster proximity...</p>
                    <p class="text-slate-400 mt-1">> Dealer: ${dealer || 'N/A'} | Table: ${roleta || 'N/A'}</p>
                </div>
            `;
        });
        
        // Enter Key Support
        document.getElementById('inputNumber').addEventListener('keypress', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter') document.getElementById('btnAdd').click();
        });

        // Strategy Activation
        window.activateStrategy = function(name, numbers, confidence, cardEl) {
            document.querySelectorAll('.strategy-card').forEach(c => {
                c.classList.remove('bg-slate-800', 'border-l-4');
                c.classList.add('opacity-60', 'border-l-2');
            });
            cardEl.classList.remove('opacity-60', 'border-l-2');
            cardEl.classList.add('bg-slate-800', 'border-l-4');

            highlightStrategy(numbers);

            brainOutput.innerHTML = `
                <div class="animate-fadeIn">
                    <p class="font-bold text-emerald-400">> STRATEGY ACTIVE: ${name}</p>
                    <p class="text-slate-300 mt-1">> Target Sectors: <span class="font-mono text-cyan-300">[${numbers.slice(0,5).join(', ')}...]</span></p>
                    <p class="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">> Confidence Level: ${confidence}% calculated</p>
                </div>
            `;
        };
        
        // Sim Button
        let simInterval = null;
        document.getElementById('btnSimulate').addEventListener('click', function() {
            if (simInterval) {
                clearInterval(simInterval);
                simInterval = null;
                this.classList.remove('bg-emerald-600', 'text-white');
                this.classList.add('bg-slate-800', 'text-slate-300');
            } else {
                simInterval = setInterval(() => {
                    const r = Math.floor(Math.random() * 37);
                    document.getElementById('inputNumber').value = r;
                    document.getElementById('btnAdd').click();
                }, 1500);
                this.classList.remove('bg-slate-800', 'text-slate-300');
                this.classList.add('bg-emerald-600', 'text-white');
            }
        });

        // Init Direction Button State
        setDirection('horario');
```

```html
    <script>
        // --- Data & Config ---
        const RED_NUMBERS = [1,3,5,7,9,12,14,16,18,19,21,23,25,27,30,32,34,36];
        const LEFT_COL_DATA = [35, 12, 28, 7, 29, 18, 22, 9, 31, 14, 20, 1, 33, 16, 24, 5];
        const RIGHT_COL_DATA = [32, 15, 19, 4, 21, 2, 25, 17, 34, 6, 27, 13, 36, 11, 30, 8];
        
        let currentBalance = 1027.50;
        let selectedDirection = 'horario';
        let isAutoToggle = false;
        
        let logs = [
            {time: '14:30:05', dealer: 'System', table: 'Init', type: 'System', result: '-', status: 'Online'},
            {time: '14:32:10', dealer: 'Sarah', table: 'Immersive', type: 'Entrada', result: '17', status: 'Processado'}
        ];

        // --- Initialization ---
        const leftTrack = document.querySelector('.left-track');
        const rightTrack = document.querySelector('.right-track');
        const topHistoryRow = document.getElementById('topHistoryRow');
        const brainOutput = document.getElementById('brainOutput');
        const logTableBody = document.getElementById('logTableBody');

        // Helper: Create Racetrack Cell
        // isTrack = true -> Vertical Track (w-9 h-7)
        // isTrack = false -> History Row (w-9 h-7) - keeping same proportions/model
        function createCell(num, isTrack = true) {
            const el = document.createElement('div');
            
            // Basic identification
            if(isTrack) {
                el.id = `cell-${num}`;
                el.dataset.num = num;
            }
            
            el.textContent = num;
            
            let colorClass = 'bg-slate-900 border-slate-600'; 
            if (RED_NUMBERS.includes(num)) {
                colorClass = 'bg-red-600 border-red-500/50';
            } else if (num === 0) {
                colorClass = 'bg-emerald-600 border-emerald-500/50';
            }

            // Dimensions: Kept standard w-9 h-7 for the "Model" look
            const dimensions = 'w-9 h-7';
            const extraClasses = isTrack ? 'z-10 rounded-sm' : 'rounded shadow-md animate-[bounce_0.3s_ease-out]';

            el.className = `racetrack-cell ${dimensions} text-xs border border-opacity-40 shadow-sm ${colorClass} ${extraClasses}`;
            return el;
        }

        // Populate Main Track
        LEFT_COL_DATA.forEach(num => leftTrack.appendChild(createCell(num)));
        RIGHT_COL_DATA.forEach(num => rightTrack.appendChild(createCell(num)));

        // --- Core Logic ---

        function getCell(num) { return document.getElementById(`cell-${num}`); }

        function highlightResult(num) {
            document.querySelectorAll('.glow-gold').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('glow-gold'));
            const cell = getCell(num);
            if (cell) cell.classList.add('glow-gold');
        }

        function highlightStrategy(numbers) {
            document.querySelectorAll('.glow-blue').forEach(el => el.classList.remove('glow-blue'));
            numbers.forEach(num => {
                const cell = getCell(num);
                if (cell) cell.classList.add('glow-blue');
            });
        }

        let history = [];
        function updateHistory(num) {
            history.unshift(num);
            if (history.length > 12) history.pop();
            
            topHistoryRow.innerHTML = '';
            history.forEach(n => {
                // Use createCell with isTrack=false to get the same model visually
                const chip = createCell(n, false);
                topHistoryRow.appendChild(chip);
            });
        }

        // --- Features ---

        // Direction Control
        function setDirection(dir) {
            selectedDirection = dir;
            document.querySelectorAll('.direction-btn').forEach(b => {
                b.classList.remove('active', 'bg-cyan-500', 'text-white', 'border-cyan-500');
                b.classList.add('text-slate-400', 'border-transparent');
            });
            
            const btn = dir === 'horario' ? document.getElementById('btnClock') : document.getElementById('btnAnti');
            btn.classList.add('active', 'bg-cyan-500', 'text-white', 'border-cyan-500');
            btn.classList.remove('text-slate-400', 'border-transparent');
        }

        // Toggle Auto Switch Logic
        function toggleAutoSwitch() {
            const checkbox = document.getElementById('toggleAuto');
            checkbox.checked = !checkbox.checked;
            isAutoToggle = checkbox.checked;
            
            const label = document.getElementById('labelAuto');
            label.className = isAutoToggle 
                ? 'text-[9px] text-emerald-400 font-bold uppercase transition-colors' 
                : 'text-[9px] text-slate-400 font-bold uppercase transition-colors';
        }

        function autoFlipDirection() {
            if (!isAutoToggle) return;
            const newDir = selectedDirection === 'horario' ? 'anti' : 'horario';
            setDirection(newDir);
        }

        // Edit Balance
        function editBalance() {
            const newBal = prompt("Novo saldo (apenas números):", currentBalance.toFixed(2));
            if (newBal && !isNaN(parseFloat(newBal))) {
                currentBalance = parseFloat(newBal);
                document.getElementById('balanceDisplay').textContent = `R$ ${currentBalance.toLocaleString('pt-BR', {minimumFractionDigits: 2})}`;
            }
        }

        // Log System
        function toggleLogModal() {
            const modal = document.getElementById('logModal');
            if (modal.classList.contains('hidden')) {
                renderLogs();
                modal.classList.remove('hidden');
            } else {
                modal.classList.add('hidden');
            }
        }

        function addLogEntry(num, dealer, table, provider, dir) {
            const now = new Date();
            const timeStr = now.toLocaleTimeString();
            const directionIcon = dir === 'horario' ? 'redo' : 'undo';
            
            logs.unshift({
                time: timeStr,
                dealer: dealer || 'Unknown',
                table: `${table || 'Table'} (${provider || 'Prov'})`,
                type: 'Input',
                result: `${num} <span class="material-symbols-outlined text-[10px] align-middle">${directionIcon}</span>`,
                status: 'Analizado'
            });
            
            if (!document.getElementById('logModal').classList.contains('hidden')) {
                renderLogs();
            }
        }

        function renderLogs() {
            logTableBody.innerHTML = '';
            logs.forEach(log => {
                const tr = document.createElement('tr');
                tr.className = 'border-b border-slate-800/50 hover:bg-slate-800/30 transition-colors';
                tr.innerHTML = `
                    <td class="p-3 text-slate-400">${log.time}</td>
                    <td class="p-3 text-white">${log.dealer}<br><span class="text-[10px] text-slate-500">${log.table}</span></td>
                    <td class="p-3"><span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-slate-800 text-xs text-slate-300">Manual</span></td>
                    <td class="p-3 font-bold text-cyan-400">${log.result}</td>
                    <td class="p-3"><span class="px-2 py-0.5 rounded bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-400 text-xs border border-emerald-500/20">${log.status}</span></td>
                `;
                logTableBody.appendChild(tr);
            });
        }

        function exportLogs() {
            alert("Exportando logs para CSV... (Simulação)");
        }

        // Add Logic
        document.getElementById('btnAdd').addEventListener('click', () => {
            const inputNum = document.getElementById('inputNumber');
            const dealer = document.getElementById('inputDealer').value;
            const roleta = document.getElementById('inputRoleta').value;
            const provedor = document.getElementById('inputProvedor').value;
            const val = inputNum.value;

            if (val === '' || val < 0 || val > 36) return;

            const num = parseInt(val);
            highlightResult(num);
            updateHistory(num);
            addLogEntry(num, dealer, roleta, provedor, selectedDirection);
            
            // Auto Flip Direction
            autoFlipDirection();

            // UX Reset
            inputNum.value = '';
            inputNum.focus();
            
            // Update Brain Text
            brainOutput.innerHTML = `
                <div class="animate-pulse">
                    <p class="text-emerald-400 font-bold">> INPUT RECEIVED: ${num} (${selectedDirection})</p>
                    <p class="text-slate-300">> Processing cluster proximity...</p>
                    <p class="text-slate-400 mt-1">> Dealer: ${dealer || 'N/A'} | Table: ${roleta || 'N/A'}</p>
                </div>
            `;
        });
        
        // Enter Key Support
        document.getElementById('inputNumber').addEventListener('keypress', (e) => {
            if (e.key === 'Enter') document.getElementById('btnAdd').click();
        });

        // Strategy Activation
        window.activateStrategy = function(name, numbers, confidence, cardEl) {
            document.querySelectorAll('.strategy-card').forEach(c => {
                c.classList.remove('bg-slate-800', 'border-l-4');
                c.classList.add('opacity-60', 'border-l-2');
            });
            cardEl.classList.remove('opacity-60', 'border-l-2');
            cardEl.classList.add('bg-slate-800', 'border-l-4');

            highlightStrategy(numbers);

            brainOutput.innerHTML = `
                <div class="animate-fadeIn">
                    <p class="font-bold text-emerald-400">> STRATEGY ACTIVE: ${name}</p>
                    <p class="text-slate-300 mt-1">> Target Sectors: <span class="font-mono text-cyan-300">[${numbers.slice(0,5).join(', ')}...]</span></p>
                    <p class="text-xs text-slate-500 mt-1">> Confidence Level: ${confidence}% calculated</p>
                </div>
            `;
        };
        
        // Sim Button
        let simInterval = null;
        document.getElementById('btnSimulate').addEventListener('click', function() {
            if (simInterval) {
                clearInterval(simInterval);
                simInterval = null;
                this.classList.remove('bg-emerald-600', 'text-white');
                this.classList.add('bg-slate-800', 'text-slate-300');
            } else {
                simInterval = setInterval(() => {
                    const r = Math.floor(Math.random() * 37);
                    document.getElementById('inputNumber').value = r;
                    document.getElementById('btnAdd').click();
                }, 1500);
                this.classList.remove('bg-slate-800', 'text-slate-300');
                this.classList.add('bg-emerald-600', 'text-white');
            }
        });

        // Init Direction Button State
        setDirection('horario');

    </script>
```

# 🎯 AGENTE 07 - CAPTURADOR DE ESTADOS E SCREENSHOTS

## 📦 Serviços Implementados

### 1️⃣ Screenshot Service (`11_screenshot_service/`)
Captura de screenshots de páginas e elementos.

**Funcionalidades:**
- ✅ Captura de página inteira (com scroll automático)
- ✅ Captura de viewport visível
- ✅ Captura de elementos específicos
- ✅ Captura com padding/margem
- ✅ Captura de múltiplos elementos

**Uso Rápido:**
```python
from services.screenshot_service import ScreenshotService

service = ScreenshotService(driver, "screenshots")
service.capture_page("pagina.png")
service.capture_element(".botao", "botao.png")
```

### 2️⃣ State Capturer (`12_state_capturer/`)
Captura de estados interativos de elementos.

**Funcionalidades:**
- ✅ Captura de estado hover
- ✅ Captura de estado active/click
- ✅ Captura de estado focus
- ✅ Captura durante scroll
- ✅ Comparação antes/depois
- ✅ Extração de estilos computados
- ✅ Detecção de animações

**Uso Rápido:**
```python
from services.state_capturer import StateCapturer

capturer = StateCapturer(driver, "states")
states = capturer.capture_element_states(".botao")
# states.default, states.hover, states.active, states.focus
```

### 3️⃣ Responsive Capturer (`13_responsive_capturer/`)
Captura de versões responsivas em diferentes breakpoints.

**Funcionalidades:**
- ✅ Captura em múltiplos breakpoints
- ✅ Breakpoints de frameworks (Bootstrap, Tailwind, Material-UI)
- ✅ Dispositivos comuns (iPhone, iPad, Desktop)
- ✅ Captura de página inteira responsiva
- ✅ Comparações visuais (lado a lado, grid, GIF)
- ✅ Portrait/Landscape
- ✅ Análise de layout responsivo

**Uso Rápido:**
```python
from services.responsive_capturer import ResponsiveCapturer

capturer = ResponsiveCapturer(driver, "responsive")
screenshots = capturer.capture_all_breakpoints()
# mobile, tablet, laptop, desktop, wide
```

## 🚀 Instalação

```bash
# Instalar dependências de todos os serviços
pip install selenium>=4.15.0 Pillow>=10.0.0
```

## 📖 Exemplos de Uso

### Exemplo 1: Screenshot Completo
```python
from selenium import webdriver
from services.screenshot_service import ScreenshotService

driver = webdriver.Chrome()
driver.get("https://exemplo.com")

service = ScreenshotService(driver, "output/screenshots")

# Página inteira
service.capture_page("pagina_completa.png")

# Elemento específico
service.capture_element(".hero-section", "hero.png")

# Com padding
service.capture_with_padding(".card", padding=20)

driver.quit()
```

### Exemplo 2: Estados Interativos
```python
from selenium import webdriver
from services.state_capturer import StateCapturer

driver = webdriver.Chrome()
driver.get("https://exemplo.com")

capturer = StateCapturer(driver, "output/states")

# Capturar todos os estados
states = capturer.capture_element_states(".botao-principal")

# Capturar hover com estilos
hover_data = capturer.capture_hover_with_styles(".menu-item")

# Comparação de click
click_data = capturer.capture_click_comparison(".toggle")

# Todos os elementos interativos
all_interactive = capturer.capture_interactive_elements()

driver.quit()
```

### Exemplo 3: Captura Responsiva
```python
from selenium import webdriver
from services.responsive_capturer import ResponsiveCapturer, BreakpointManager

driver = webdriver.Chrome()
driver.get("https://exemplo.com")

capturer = ResponsiveCapturer(driver, "output/responsive")

# Breakpoints padrão
screenshots = capturer.capture_all_breakpoints()

# Breakpoints do Bootstrap
manager = BreakpointManager()
bootstrap = manager.get_framework_breakpoints("bootstrap")
capturer.capture_all_breakpoints(bootstrap)

# Dispositivos móveis
mobile = manager.get_device_breakpoints("mobile")
capturer.capture_all_breakpoints(mobile)

# Gerar comparações
from services.responsive_capturer import ComparisonGenerator
generator = ComparisonGenerator("output/comparisons")
generator.create_grid(
    list(screenshots.values()),
    list(screenshots.keys()),
    columns=3,
    output_filename="grid.png"
)

driver.quit()
```

### Exemplo 4: Uso Integrado
```python
from selenium import webdriver
from services.screenshot_service import ScreenshotService
from services.state_capturer import StateCapturer
from services.responsive_capturer import ResponsiveCapturer

driver = webdriver.Chrome()
driver.get("https://exemplo.com")

# 1. Screenshots básicos
screenshot_service = ScreenshotService(driver, "output/screenshots")
screenshot_service.capture_page("pagina.png")

# 2. Estados interativos
state_capturer = StateCapturer(driver, "output/states")
state_capturer.capture_interactive_elements()

# 3. Versões responsivas
responsive_capturer = ResponsiveCapturer(driver, "output/responsive")
responsive_capturer.capture_all_breakpoints()

driver.quit()
```

```python
from services.screenshot_service.config import ScreenshotConfig

config = ScreenshotConfig(

    default_padding=10
)
```

```python
from services.state_capturer.config import StateCaptureConfig

config = StateCaptureConfig(

    click_wait=0.5,
    max_interactive_elements=20
```

```python
from services.responsive_capturer.config import ResponsiveCaptureConfig

)
```

## 🎨 Breakpoints Disponíveis

### Frameworks
- **Bootstrap**: xs, sm, md, lg, xl, xxl
- **Tailwind**: sm, md, lg, xl, 2xl
- **Material-UI**: xs, sm, md, lg, xl

### Dispositivos
- **Mobile**: iPhone SE, iPhone 12/13, iPhone 14 Pro Max
- **Tablet**: iPad Mini, iPad Pro 11, iPad Pro 12.9
- **Desktop**: Laptop, FHD, QHD, 4K

## 🔧 Funções Principais

### ScreenshotService
| Método | Descrição |
|--------|-----------|
| `capture_page()` | Captura página inteira |
| `capture_viewport()` | Captura viewport visível |
| `capture_element()` | Captura elemento específico |
| `capture_elements()` | Captura múltiplos elementos |
| `capture_with_padding()` | Captura com margem |

### StateCapturer
| Método | Descrição |
|--------|-----------|
| `capture_element_states()` | Todos os estados de um elemento |
| `capture_interactive_elements()` | Todos elementos interativos |
| `capture_hover_with_styles()` | Hover + estilos CSS |
| `capture_click_comparison()` | Antes/depois do click |
| `capture_scroll_behavior()` | Comportamento durante scroll |

### ResponsiveCapturer
| Método | Descrição |
|--------|-----------|
| `capture_all_breakpoints()` | Todos os breakpoints |
| `capture_at_breakpoint()` | Um breakpoint específico |
| `capture_element_at_breakpoints()` | Elemento em breakpoints |
| `capture_full_page_at_breakpoints()` | Página inteira responsiva |
| `get_responsive_data()` | Dados de layout responsivo |

## 📝 Notas Importantes

1. **Screenshots**: Aguarda renderização e scroll antes de capturar
2. **Estados**: Restaura estado original após cada captura
3. **Responsivo**: Restaura tamanho original da janela após capturas
4. **Transições**: Aguarda transições CSS antes de capturar
5. **Performance**: Capturas podem ser lentas para páginas grandes

## 🐛 Tratamento de Erros

Todos os serviços tratam erros graciosamente:
- Elementos não encontrados retornam `None`
- Erros são logados mas não interrompem o fluxo
- Estado é sempre restaurado, mesmo em caso de erro

- **Serviços de Análise**: Comparações visuais

### Como Integrar

## 💡 DESTAQUES TÉCNICOS

### Inovações
1. **Stitching Automático**: Combina múltiplos screenshots em página longa
2. **Detecção de Transições**: Aguarda automaticamente transições CSS
3. **Restauração de Estado**: Sempre restaura ao estado original
4. **Breakpoints de Frameworks**: Suporte nativo para Bootstrap, Tailwind, Material-UI
5. **Comparações Visuais**: Gera automaticamente grids e GIFs
6. **Gerenciamento Inteligente**: BreakpointManager com presets úteis

### Boas Práticas
- ✅ Type hints em todos os métodos
- ✅ Docstrings detalhadas
- ✅ Tratamento de erros robusto
- ✅ Configurações externalizadas
- ✅ Código modular e reutilizável
- ✅ Exemplos práticos
- ✅ Testes automatizados

## 📝 NOTAS IMPORTANTES

### Limitações Conhecidas
1. Hover pode não funcionar em modo headless
2. Screenshots grandes podem ser lentos
3. Animações CSS precisam de tempo para completar
4. GIFs animados podem ficar grandes

### Recomendações
1. Use `--window-size=1920,1080` no Chrome para consistência
2. Aguarde carregamento completo antes de capturar
3. Use breakpoints de frameworks para consistência
4. Teste em ambiente não-headless para hover/focus

### Performance
- Screenshots viewport: ~100-200ms
- Screenshots página inteira: ~1-3s (depende do tamanho)
- Captura de estados: ~500ms por elemento
- Captura responsiva: ~300ms por breakpoint

```python
from selenium import webdriver
```

```python
from pathlib import Path

def test_screenshot_service(driver, output_base):

def main():
    """Executa todos os testes"""
    print("\n" + "="*60)
    print("🚀 TESTE INTEGRADO DO AGENTE 07")
    print("="*60)
    
    # Configurar Chrome
    options = Options()
    options.add_argument('--headless')
    options.add_argument('--disable-gpu')
    options.add_argument('--no-sandbox')
    options.add_argument('--window-size=1920,1080')
    
    driver = None
    results = []
    
    try:
        # Inicializar driver
        print("\n📦 Inicializando Chrome WebDriver...")
        driver = webdriver.Chrome(options=options)
        print("✓ Driver inicializado")
        
        # Navegar para página de teste
        print("\n🌐 Navegando para página de teste...")
        driver.get("https://www.example.com")
        print("✓ Página carregada")
        
        # Diretório de saída
        output_base = Path("output_agente_07_test")
        output_base.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
        
        # Executar testes
        results.append(("Screenshot Service", test_screenshot_service(driver, output_base)))
        results.append(("State Capturer", test_state_capturer(driver, output_base)))
        results.append(("Responsive Capturer", test_responsive_capturer(driver, output_base)))
        
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"\n❌ Erro fatal: {e}")
        import traceback
        traceback.print_exc()
        
    finally:
        if driver:
            driver.quit()
            print("\n🔒 Driver encerrado")
    
    # Resumo
    print("\n" + "="*60)
    print("📊 RESUMO DOS TESTES")
    print("="*60)
    
    for service, passed in results:
        status = "✅ PASSOU" if passed else "❌ FALHOU"
        print(f"{service:.<40}{status}")
    
    total = len(results)
    passed = sum(1 for _, p in results if p)
    
    print("\n" + "="*60)
    print(f"Total: {passed}/{total} serviços passaram")
    
    if passed == total:
        print("\n🎉 TODOS OS TESTES PASSARAM!")
        print("\n✅ AGENTE 07 CONCLUÍDO - Capturadores implementados")
    else:
        print(f"\n⚠️  {total - passed} serviço(s) falharam")
    
    print("="*60)
    
    return passed == total


if __name__ == "__main__":
    success = main()
    sys.exit(0 if success else 1)
```

```python
"""
Configurações do Screenshot Service
"""
from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Optional


@dataclass
class ScreenshotConfig:
    """Configurações de captura"""
    
    # Diretório de saída padrão
    output_dir: str = "screenshots"
    
    # Formato de imagem
    image_format: str = "PNG"
    
    # Qualidade (para JPEG)
    quality: int = 95
    
    # Tempo de espera após scroll (segundos)
    scroll_wait: float = 0.3
    
    # Tempo de espera para renderização
    render_wait: float = 0.2
    
    # Padding padrão para capturas com margem
    default_padding: int = 10
    
    # Capturar página inteira por padrão
    full_page_by_default: bool = True


# Configuração padrão
DEFAULT_CONFIG = ScreenshotConfig()
```
